If it had wheels, they could flip it, and they led a band of pioneers intent on breaking ground in a new sport before multitudes of fans at the X Games and beyond. In the wake of the devastating freestyle snowmobile accident that killed his older brother, Caleb, at Aspen's Winter X Games, Colten managed to return to win gold. He describes how, in the pursuit of happiness, we can lose everything, only to find it again-- often in the most unlikely place.
